name: Agent self-improvement
description: Evaluate a managed AI prompt and let an agent create one reviewable self-improvement in an isolated worktree. The source repository is never changed automatically.

parameters.label: Improvement name
parameters.tooltip: Name the build that OpenOrbit creates for this recurring self-improvement workflow.

parameters.label: Git repository
parameters.tooltip: Absolute path to the local repository or workspace that this evaluation may inspect.

parameters.label: Managed prompt path
parameters.tooltip: Path relative to the repository for the prompt evaluated before the coding agent creates its isolated proposal.

parameters.label: Test case name
parameters.tooltip: Short, stable name shown for this fixed evaluation case.

parameters.label: User request
parameters.placeholder: e.g. I need a refund, but I do not have my order number.
parameters.tooltip: The exact user request or task supplied to the evaluated target.

parameters.label: Success condition
parameters.placeholder: e.g. The response is complete, grounded, and has no error.
parameters.tooltip: Observable evidence required for this case to be considered successful.

parameters.label: AI model profile
parameters.tooltip: Select an existing AI model profile, or create one for this build.

parameters.label: AI coding agent
parameters.tooltip: Select the locally installed coding agent that will inspect, modify, and validate a change in an isolated proposal worktree.

parameters.label: Agent CLI options
parameters.tooltip: Optional command-line arguments passed to the selected agent.

runner.name: ${build_name} runner
runner.description: Isolated agent self-improvement runner created by Quick Start.

prompt_template.name: ${build_name} policy
prompt_template.content: Evaluate the managed AI prompt strictly against retained responses from the real target AI. Compare every response with its fixed user request and acceptance criterion. Check task clarity, grounding in observable evidence, uncertainty and missing-context handling, safety boundaries, and actionable next steps. For each unmet criterion observed in an actual response, report one concrete, non-duplicative issue with the evidence needed to validate a change. Do not claim that a source change has been applied. Keep the recommendation specific enough for a coding agent to create one small, reviewable diff in an isolated worktree. Return empty arrays only when every criterion is demonstrably met.

test_case_set.name: ${build_name} validation
test_case_set.description: A fixed managed-AI validation case created by Quick Start.

build.name: ${build_name}
build.purpose: Evaluate a managed AI prompt and create one reviewable isolated-worktree self-improvement from evidence retained from the real target AI.
